title: aiBytes published feed
description: The contract between the producer (packages/fetchers, run on a schedule) and the consumers (the aiBytes_ web app and Chrome extension, which fetch this over HTTP from GitHub Pages). Breaking this breaks a shipped Chrome extension that cannot be hotfixed - add fields, never rename or remove them.

schemaVersion.description: Bumped only for a breaking change. Consumers must refuse a version they do not know.

generatedAt.description: UTC timestamp of the producing run.

asOf.description: The as-of date the window was cut from.

sources.description: One entry per source in this run. Order is not significant.

name.description: Stable source id, e.g. hackernews. Matches the fetcher's NAME.

path.description: Path to the source payload, relative to this index file. Must be relative with no parent-directory segments - a consumer resolves it against the index URL.

count.description: Number of items in the payload.

itemsKey.description: Key inside the payload holding the item array (stories, repos, articles, posts).

error.description: Present when this source failed. The payload may be stale or absent; consumers should render the rest of the feed rather than fail.
